On a 390px screen, stack the three cards vertically, shrink the UI mockups to fit full card width, and keep the two CTAs stacked or placed side by side if space allows, preserving the number-heading-subcopy order.
ai.note:
- Three equal cards in a row, each: number, serif heading, short subcopy, simplified UI mockup.
- Single terracotta accent used for numbers, active states, icons and primary button.
- Cream/beige layered backgrounds with soft rounded corners throughout.
- Serif display headline with italic accent word sits above the grid.
- Flat UI mockups (date picker, line chart, list rows) replace photography.
- Mobile: stack cards vertically, scale mockups to card width, keep CTA pair below.

MV2398B8Q3PZY.name: Function Health — check your health
MV2398B8Q3PZY.humanNote: The transparent or glass effect navbar gives elegance and feels high tech combined with the mirroring effect on the hero video and minimal but intentional composition of the hero section. The stats are not combersome, the headline and button and label combination is perfectly balanced.

ai.description: Full-bleed hero video background of a runner silhouetted in misty forest light, with a translucent dark overlay for text contrast. A glassmorphic sticky navbar sits on top with a logo mark, horizontal text nav, login link, and a pill-shaped CTA button. Above it runs a thin solid-color announcement bar. Left-aligned hero copy stacks a pill badge, large italic serif headline, supporting sans paragraph, and a rounded CTA button. Bottom-right of the hero holds a three-column stat strip separated by vertical rules, with a video pause toggle in the corner.
ai.tag_rationale: The navbar uses a frosted glass/transparent surface over the moving video, giving the techy-elegant lift the note calls out, while the restrained stat row and single CTA keep the composition from feeling crowded.
ai.layout: Full-width single hero block, no grid columns visible except the implicit left text column and right-aligned stat cluster. Vertical rhythm: announcement bar, nav, large open video area, then copy block anchored bottom-left and stats bottom-right, all within generous negative space over the video. Alignment is left for the headline/CTA stack and right for the numeric stats, creating balance across the width.
ai.typography: Headline set in a large italic serif ("Check your health.") contrasting with grotesk/sans-serif used for nav, body copy, stat labels and buttons. Stat numbers are bold sans at a mid-size scale, paired with smaller regular-weight captions beneath. Tracking is tight on the serif headline, slightly looser on uppercase badge text.
ai.color_imagery: Warm terracotta accent bar at top, otherwise a muted cream/off-white and dark charcoal-green palette drawn from the video's forest tones. Video is full-bleed and continuously playing (with pause control), treated with a soft gradient/mist overlay rather than hard color blocking. Buttons use cream fill with dark terracotta text, pill-shaped, no drop shadow.
ai.interaction: Autoplaying background video with a manual pause/play toggle button bottom-right; nav likely reveals dropdowns on hover though not shown here.
ai.borrow: Borrow the glass navbar over a looping background video/image for a shop hero, the left-copy/right-stat balance, and the single pill CTA discipline. On a 390px phone, drop the three-column stat strip to a stacked or horizontally scrollable row, collapse nav into a hamburger, keep the italic serif headline but reduce size, and ensure the video overlay darkens enough for legibility at full width. Avoid over-animating; one subtle video loop is enough for a small shop.
ai.note:
- Full-bleed looping video hero with soft gradient overlay for text legibility
- Glassmorphic/transparent sticky navbar floating over the moving footage
- Large italic serif headline paired with grotesk body and nav type
- Left-aligned copy stack (badge, headline, text, pill CTA) balanced by right-aligned numeric stat strip with vertical dividers
- Warm terracotta announcement bar and cream pill buttons against muted forest tones
- Manual video pause control tucked bottom-right corner

MV15N1X2WBYEM.name: The Print Loft  Fine Art Prints on Hahnemühle Archival Paper
MV15N1X2WBYEM.humanNote: Great way to display prints or products in detail and in context, with hover effect and creative gallery slider component. Also good rolling fix banner at the bottom.

ai.description: A horizontally scrolling product gallery displays framed art prints propped on wooden easels against a flat sage-green background, each card bleeding off the edge of the viewport to hint at more content. A pill-shaped toggle ("ARTWORK" / "IN ROOM") sits top right next to a "VIEW ALL" link, letting users switch between product-only and lifestyle/room views. Below each easel image, the artwork title, price ("from €XX"), and an optional "LIMITED EDITION" badge are left-aligned in small caps. A marquee ticker runs along the bottom edge inside a dashed-border strip, repeating the brand tagline in bold condensed type.
ai.tag_rationale: The note calls out the hover/slider gallery and the rolling bottom banner, both clearly visible: the staggered easel cards invite horizontal scroll/drag, and the dotted-border marquee repeats the brand line in a continuous loop.
ai.layout: Asymmetric horizontal row of partially cropped cards, uneven widths creating a staggered rhythm rather than a strict grid; generous negative space between easels; caption block left-aligned under each image with consistent baseline for title/price; header uses a simple flex row with logo left, toggle and view-all right, all on a single line.
ai.typography: Bold grotesk wordmark at large size for "THE ARCHIVE"; small-caps, letter-spaced labels for toggle and badges; handwritten/script-style serif for artwork titles contrasting with the structured grotesk elsewhere; condensed bold caps used in the marquee for a punchy, poster-like tone.
ai.color_imagery: Muted sage-green background unifies the shelf-like staging; wood-tone easels add warmth and texture; artwork images themselves carry the only saturated color (sky blues, golds, night blacks), making each print pop against the neutral backdrop; badges use solid black pills with white text for contrast.
ai.interaction: Implied horizontal drag/scroll through the gallery (cards cut off at both screen edges), toggle switch between artwork and in-room views, and a continuously scrolling marquee ticker at the bottom.
ai.borrow: Adopt the staged/propped product photography and the neutral background-with-wood-texture trick to make simple products feel gallery-worthy; the horizontal card slider and toggle work well on a 390px phone if reduced to one visible card plus a sliver of the next, with swipe replacing drag; the marquee banner adapts easily to full-width on mobile but should slow down and reduce text length to avoid clutter.
ai.note:
- Horizontal card carousel with partially cropped edge cards implying scroll
- Products staged on physical props (easels) against flat muted background for gallery feel
- Small-caps pill toggle switches between two viewing modes
- Left-aligned captions pairing script-style title with small price/badge row
- Bottom marquee ticker in dashed-border strip repeats tagline in bold condensed caps
- Mobile: show one card plus sliver of next, swap drag for swipe, slow marquee speed

MV14UPMYQOXW0.name: Home  Cabalar Meat Co.
MV14UPMYQOXW0.humanNote: Playful and bold design, with large fun typography and tilted photos, and the little fun illustration icon floating on top. Gives the feeling of a fun and high paced environment and suits the storytelling in the copy.

ai.description: Split two-column hero with wordmark logo and three pill-shaped nav buttons top right. Left column holds a slightly rotated, rounded-corner photo of a butcher at work; a small cartoon mascot sticker overlaps its bottom-left corner. Right column stacks a small bold headline, an oversized condensed display headline, a paragraph of narrative copy, and a pill-shaped outlined CTA button. All on flat white background in a single accent green.
ai.tag_rationale: Tagged gastro/about-page/photography/typography because the layout combines a tilted documentary-style kitchen photo with a chunky condensed display headline and storytelling copy, matching the noted playful, fast-paced butcher-shop narrative.
ai.layout: Two-column grid roughly 45/55 split, image left and text right, both vertically centered within the viewport. Nav sits top right as three horizontally spaced pill buttons. Headline block stacks small caps line above a much larger condensed display line, then body copy, then CTA, all left-aligned with generous line spacing. The photo is rotated a few degrees off-grid, breaking the otherwise rigid alignment.
ai.typography: Display headline in a heavy condensed sans/slab, all caps, very large scale creating strong contrast with the small caps intro line above it and the regular-weight body paragraph below. Logo wordmark uses a rounded chunky display face matching the playful tone. Single color (dark green) used throughout for all type, no secondary hierarchy color.
ai.color_imagery: Monochrome dark green on white background for all type, buttons and line work. Photo is full color documentary style, desaturated by the surrounding whitespace, placed in a rounded-corner frame and tilted for an off-kilter, handmade feel. Small flat illustrated mascot sticker adds a secondary graphic color accent.
ai.interaction: Implied hover states on pill nav buttons and CTA button; likely scroll-triggered entrance or tilt animation on the photo given the playful note.
ai.borrow: A small shop could borrow the tilted rounded photo plus mascot sticker trick and the oversized condensed headline to inject personality without extra color; keep to one accent ink color for simplicity. On a 390px screen, stack the photo above the text, shrink the display headline to 2-3 lines, collapse the three pill nav buttons into a hamburger or two stacked pills, and keep the CTA full width under the copy. Drop the rotation angle on mobile or reduce it so the photo doesn't overflow the frame.
ai.note:
- Split hero: tilted rounded-corner photo left, text stack right
- Oversized condensed all-caps display headline over small-caps intro line
- Single accent green used for all type, buttons and outlines on white
- Pill-shaped nav buttons (filled + outlined) and outlined CTA button
- Small flat illustrated mascot sticker overlapping photo corner
- Mobile: stack photo over text, shrink headline to 2-3 lines, collapse nav

MV14QHL7CVGRJ.name: Home  Cabalar Meat Co.
MV14QHL7CVGRJ.humanNote: The little worm slides in with scroll, the large type states the value of their business and opening hours are clearly displayed. The one color choice is also often seen in this type of website, this one being an example of how to do it well.

ai.description: Two-column text section on white background. Left column holds a large block of body copy set in a rounded sans-serif describing the business, running seven lines without paragraph breaks. Right column is narrower and stacked: a short "Hours of Operation" list with day/time pairs on separate lines, followed by a hand-drawn cartoon character (a snake in a cap) holding an "Open" sign. All text is a single dark green, no other accent colors.
ai.tag_rationale: Tagged "Value Prop" and "gastro" because the left column is pure brand/value copy for a food business and the layout matches the gastro archetype; the note calls out the single-color palette and scroll-in illustration, both clearly visible.
ai.layout: Asymmetric two-column split, roughly 60/40, both columns top-aligned with generous left margin. Left column text wraps at a wide measure with tight line-height creating a dense paragraph block. Right column is vertically stacked into two distinct groups (hours list, then illustration) with clear vertical spacing between them. No visible grid lines, dividers or borders; separation comes purely from whitespace and column width.
ai.typography: Single rounded grotesk/sans typeface used throughout at different scales: very large size for the value-prop paragraph with tight leading, much smaller size for the hours list. No bold or italic contrast, no serif pairing; hierarchy is achieved purely through size difference. All lowercase-sentence case, no tracking tricks.
ai.color_imagery: Monochrome green-on-white palette, same dark green used for all type and the illustration linework. The mascot illustration is a simple line drawing with light dotted/halftone shading on the cap and sign, no photography, no gradients or secondary accent colors.
ai.interaction: Illustrated character is noted to animate in on scroll (slides into frame), implying a scroll-triggered entrance animation for the mascot graphic.
ai.borrow: Usable pattern for a small shop: oversized plain-language value statement paired with a compact, scannable hours block, all in one brand color to keep production simple. On a 390px screen this would need to stack into a single column, with the hours list and mascot moving below the paragraph; the large paragraph text size would need to drop significantly to avoid overwhelming the viewport, and the scroll-in animation on the mascot should be kept subtle or disabled to avoid janky mobile scroll.
ai.note:
- Two-column split: oversized value-prop paragraph left, compact hours list + mascot illustration right
- Single dark-green monochrome palette for all text and line art, no secondary accents
- Rounded sans-serif used at two scales only, hierarchy by size not weight
- Hand-drawn mascot with light dotted shading, animates/slides in on scroll
- Hours listed as plain stacked day:time lines, no table or icons
- On mobile, stack to single column: shrink paragraph size, move hours/mascot below copy

MV14OGI824QMN.name: Home  Cabalar Meat Co.

ai.color_imagery: White page background with a single dark forest green brand color used for logo, primary CTA fill, and link text; otherwise neutral white and black text. Hero imagery is a desaturated, warm-toned video still (kitchen interior, stainless counter, checkered paper) that reads almost sepia against the clean white chrome. No gradients, overlays or filters on the photography beyond natural lighting.
ai.description: Full-width hero built as a video player framed by a thick white margin and soft rounded corners, sitting directly under a flat top navigation bar. The nav is a simple wordmark logo left-aligned and three pill-shaped buttons right-aligned (one filled, two outlined). The video shows two staff members behind a counter handing baskets of food toward camera, shot in a documentary/behind-the-scenes style. No text overlay sits on top of the video itself; all messaging lives in the nav bar above.
ai.interaction: Autoplaying looped hero video, implied hover state change on pill buttons (fill/outline swap)
ai.layout: Two-zone vertical stack: slim fixed-height header bar, then a large single-column hero block that spans the full width inside a framed inset. Header uses a simple flex row — logo left, button group right, evenly spaced. The hero has generous whitespace padding around it acting as a visual frame, no grid columns inside the video itself since it's a single full-bleed asset.
ai.note:

- Hero is a full-bleed autoplay video inset with a wide white margin and rounded corners, acting as a frame

ai.tag_rationale: Matches the saved tags exactly: a gastro business (burger restaurant) using a hero video as the main device, with the framed white border and rounded corners giving it a minimal, considered feel despite the raw documentary footage.
ai.typography: Logo set in a bold, chunky display/slab typeface with interlocking letterforms for brand personality. Nav button labels use a plain grotesk sans in uppercase, small size, consistent tracking — clearly secondary to the logo mark, creating a two-tier type hierarchy of distinctive brand mark vs. neutral UI text.

MV14DOEV6WW8A.name: Maria Coassin
MV14DOEV6WW8A.humanNote: Great use of grid, sidebar section navigation, content dividers and large photography ie full width website. The sections scroll vertically and then horizontally for one section.

ai.description: A split-screen about hero with a thin left utility rail. Far left holds a vertical "ABOUT" label rotated 90°, plus a stack of navigation dots indicating section progress. The main content column (roughly 55% width) sits on a warm cream background with a large script-style magenta headline, a body paragraph with a bold vertical accent bar, and bold inline phrases. The right 45% is a full-bleed photographic panel showing a gelato maker in her kitchen holding a tray of chocolate-chip gelato. A top bar spans the full width with left text links (Get in touch, FAQ), a center logotype in a thin serif/script peach font, and right-aligned Menu button plus hamburger icon.
ai.tag_rationale: Matches the saved tags: a clear two-column grid split between text and full-height photography, a sidebar with dot navigation for section progress, and a rule-divided layout consistent with the "content dividers and large photography" note.
ai.layout: Two-column split: a narrow fixed left rail (vertical label + dot nav), a content column with headline/body, and a large right-hand image panel that runs full-bleed to the viewport edge. Top bar overlays both columns with three-part alignment (left links, centered logo, right menu controls). Thin hairline rules separate the left rail from content and content from the next section below, reinforcing a strict grid.
ai.typography: Large display script/calligraphic serif in magenta for the headline, high contrast against a plain sans-serif body copy; bold weight used for emphasis words inline. Logo wordmark uses a thin, light serif/script in peach, all caps and widely tracked. Vertical "ABOUT" label is sans-serif, condensed, letter-spaced, rotated 90°.
ai.color_imagery: Warm cream/beige background, magenta accent for headline and vertical bar, black for body text and buttons. Photography is full-color, unfiltered, documentary-style kitchen shot, cropped tightly and bled to the edge with no rounding or framing.
ai.interaction: Implied vertical scroll with a horizontal scroll behavior for this section (per note), dot navigation likely indicates active sub-section as user scrolls sideways.
ai.borrow: The split text/photo layout and dot-based section nav translate well to a small shop's about page; on a 390px phone the two columns would stack vertically, the rotated "ABOUT" label would need to become a horizontal eyebrow tag, and the dot nav could collapse into a simple progress bar or be dropped. Keep the oversized script headline as a hero moment but shrink line length to avoid awkward wraps.
ai.note:
- Split-screen layout: left text column with oversized script headline, right full-bleed kitchen photo.
- Thin left rail holds a rotated vertical label and dot-style section navigation.
- Magenta display script contrasts with plain sans body text and bold inline emphasis phrases.
- Hairline rules divide rail, content, and next section for a strict grid feel.
- Top bar: left text links, centered thin script logo, right menu button and icon.
- Mobile adaptation: stack photo under text, convert vertical label to horizontal eyebrow, simplify dot nav.

MV14AJOKD2IEX.name: Maria Coassin
MV14AJOKD2IEX.humanNote: The font is an elegant modern serif, looks good in mid size quote headlines, the scroll effect of the words dropping off and disappearing is creative. The color palette is also good.

ai.description: A centered editorial text section on a warm beige background. A logotype wordmark sits top center in a peach serif display font, flanked by a minimal left nav ("Get in touch", "FAQ") and a right-aligned "Menu" with hamburger icon. Below, a large serif paragraph functions as a scroll-driven blockquote, with a faded/ghosted opening line ("Gelato is so much...") suggesting it has partially scrolled out of view, while bold-weight serif words are used inline to emphasize key phrases within the lighter-weight body text. Two small dot indicators sit at the bottom center, one in dark maroon (active) and one pale, hinting at a slide or progress indicator.
ai.tag_rationale: Tagged as Blockquote/Typography because the core element is a large serif paragraph used as a statement rather than body copy, with selective bold emphasis; the gastro archetype fits as this is a gelato business site.
ai.layout: Single centered column, generous horizontal margins, vertical stack: top nav bar, logo, large quote block, dot pagination. Text is center-aligned with tight line-height relative to the large type size, creating a dense paragraph block that reads like a poster.
ai.typography: Display serif throughout — thin/regular weight for most of the paragraph, switching to bold same-family serif for emphasized phrases, creating a two-weight contrast within a single block. Logo uses a condensed, slightly geometric serif in wide letter-spacing. Nav and menu labels are small sans-serif caps, a clear contrast to the serif headline type.
ai.color_imagery: Monochromatic warm palette: beige/cream background, dark maroon-brown text, peach-tinted logo, no photography in this section — purely typographic. One accent dot in maroon against a muted pale dot.
ai.interaction: Scroll-triggered text animation where the preceding line fades/drops out as the viewer scrolls, giving the ghosted first line effect; likely a slide/carousel behind the two dot indicators.
ai.borrow: Borrow the single-weight-swap trick for emphasis inside a serif paragraph and the warm monochrome palette — both scale well to a 390px screen, where the paragraph would just narrow to 2-3 words per line while keeping the same center alignment. Leave out the scroll-fade animation unless performance budget allows; on mobile it's easy to make such effects feel janky, so a static version with the ghosted line simply omitted is safer.
ai.note:
- Centered serif headline block used as a scroll-animated blockquote, with fading/ghosted line as prior text scrolls away
- Mixed-weight serif: regular for body, bold same-family for emphasized phrases inline
- Warm monochrome palette: cream background, maroon-brown text, peach logotype
- Minimal top bar: small sans caps nav left, hamburger menu right, centered wordmark
- Dot pagination (active/inactive) centered at bottom, implying slide progression
- On mobile, paragraph reflows to fewer words per line, keep center alignment and weight contrast, drop or simplify scroll-fade effect

MV148BOJZA604.name: Maria Coassin
MV148BOJZA604.humanNote: Great typography, scrolling headline, little bottom left widget for announcements.

ai.description: Full-bleed hero with a blurred close-up photo of a person holding a gelato cone, overlaid by a huge serif wordmark that reads "MARIA COASSIN" split across the image edges. Below it a thin nav bar lists six text links, and a second oversized headline in uppercase serif runs edge-to-edge as a marquee-style scrolling line ("...SUCCESSFUL WITH GELATO. LEARN..."), cropped at both left and right so it bleeds off screen. Top corners hold a language toggle pill (IT/EN) and a localized time/place stamp ("05:23 PM — Maniago, Italy"). Bottom corners hold a pill button ("WHAT'S NEW") and a circular scroll-down indicator with "SCROLL" label.
ai.tag_rationale: Tagged for its full-bleed photography, animated scrolling headline, and the small bottom-left utility widget; the layered serif type over a cropped portrait and the marquee text confirm the "Hero Animation" tag.
ai.layout: Single full-viewport section with layered, overlapping text on top of a full-bleed photograph; name treated as a giant display lockup centered near the top, nav condensed into a slim horizontal row beneath it, and a second massive line of type cutting across the vertical middle, overflowing the frame left and right. Corner elements (language switch, clock/location, CTA pill, scroll pill) anchor the four corners, leaving the center open for the image and type to dominate.
ai.typography: Two contrasting display faces: a flared, high-contrast serif with quirky curved counters for the name, and a bold compressed serif in all caps for the scrolling statement line; nav and small UI labels use a plain uppercase sans-serif at a much smaller tracked-out size, creating a three-tier type hierarchy.
ai.color_imagery: Warm, desaturated photo tones (skin, wood cone, cream) sit behind semi-transparent peach and off-white type; a single hot-pink pill accents the language toggle, the only saturated color on the page. Image is full-bleed and blurred/soft-focus rather than sharply cropped, giving the text layers legibility without hard masking.
ai.interaction: Implied horizontal marquee/scroll animation on the large uppercase headline, plus a scroll-down affordance bottom right; likely subtle parallax or fade on hero image as user scrolls.
ai.borrow: Borrow the layered name + marquee-headline structure for a strong personal-brand opener, and the corner-widget idea (small live stamp or CTA pill) for a sense of craft and personality on a small shop site. Leave behind the two oversized overlapping type layers and full-bleed blur on a 390px phone—stack the name, nav and tagline vertically, shrink the marquee to a single non-overlapping line or remove the animation, and move corner widgets into a compact top bar plus a single sticky bottom CTA to avoid clutter on narrow screens.
ai.note:
- Full-bleed blurred photo hero with two stacked serif type layers overlapping the image
- Giant flared-serif name lockup up top, oversized marquee-style headline bleeding off both edges mid-image
- Slim uppercase sans nav row sits between the two type layers, small tracked-out labels
- Corner widgets: language toggle pill, live time/location stamp, "what's new" pill, circular scroll indicator
- Warm desaturated photo palette with single hot-pink accent on toggle
- On mobile: drop overlapping layers, stack name/nav/tagline vertically, simplify marquee to static single line, consolidate corner widgets into top bar + one bottom CTA

ai.borrow: A shop site would rarely need three-pane layouts, but the pattern of persistent left-rail navigation plus a central scrollable results list is useful for an admin/order-management back-office. On a 390px phone this would collapse to a single column: left rail becomes a bottom tab bar or hamburger drawer, the chat panel becomes a full-screen modal, and cards stack full-width with the two action buttons kept inline below the description for thumb reach.
ai.color_imagery: Mostly white/light-gray surfaces with a single magenta/pink brand accent used for the logo mark, active tab pill, notification dot, and primary CTA buttons ("More like this!"). Avatars are flat blue circular placeholders with a generic icon, no real photography. Status text uses muted gray, while scores and tags use soft pastel badge backgrounds (pink filter pill, light gray outline buttons). No illustration or photographic imagery, purely typographic/iconographic UI.
ai.description: Three-column SaaS dashboard: a slim icon sidebar on the far left, a job-search/filter panel next to it, a central scrollable feed of job-listing cards, and a chat-style AI assistant panel on the right. The center column has a search bar with pill-shaped filter chips (Filters, Location, Experience, Posting Date, Apply Process, Exclude Jobs) above a two-column card grid of job postings. Each card contains a company logo circle, title, tags, a short description, a bulleted skills/requirements list, and footer actions (view counts, "Not exactly" / "More like this!" buttons). The right panel is a conversational thread with AI-generated job summaries and a bottom text-input bar.
ai.interaction: Implied chat-style conversational interaction on the right (agent responses, "Show agent thinking" expandable toggle), filter pills that likely open dropdowns, card-level feedback buttons ("Not exactly...", "More like this!") suggesting a recommendation-tuning interaction, and a progress-style setup checklist on the left with checked/unchecked states.
ai.layout: Three-pane grid: fixed-width icon rail (far left, ~56px), a secondary sidebar/filter column, a flexible center content area with card grid, and a fixed-width chat sidebar on the right. Center cards are arranged two-up with consistent padding, rounded corners, and stacked internal sections (header, tags, body text, bullet list, footer). Vertical rhythm is tight and dense, typical of data-heavy dashboards, with horizontal dividers separating card footer actions from content.
ai.note:
- Three-pane dashboard grid: icon rail, filter/search column, card feed, chat assistant panel.
- Pill-shaped filter chips with counts (Filters 3, Location 2, Experience 1) above a two-column card grid.
- Cards use rounded avatar circles, tag badges, bullet lists, and dual footer action buttons (reject/affirm).
- Single magenta accent color against neutral white/gray surfaces; no photography, icon-based avatars only.
- Right-hand conversational panel mimics chat UI with expandable "show thinking" toggle and bottom input bar.
- Left column shows a vertical checklist/progress tracker with checked states and a promo callout box.
ai.tag_rationale: Tagged "UI, Dashboard" because it's a dense, multi-pane SaaS product screen with sidebars, filters, cards, and a chat panel rather than any marketing or e-commerce page.
ai.typography: Grotesk sans-serif throughout, small base size (~13-14px) for dense data display, medium-weight bold for job titles and headers, regular weight for body copy, uppercase tracked small caps for the "OTHER JOBS YOU MIGHT WANT TO SEE" label. Minimal type scale contrast, prioritizing information density over hierarchy drama.

MUL78RMHMQ1Z9.name: Chicago Laser Hair Removal  Med Spa  Muse Laser Medspa
MUL78RMHMQ1Z9.humanNote: Cosmetic, laser and spa website with great type, a rather full hero section but clear hierarchy, combined with an attracive short video. Ignore the allcaps text, not always good.

ai.description: Split hero on a warm light-grey background: left column carries a large serif headline stacked in two size tiers, a smaller all-caps subline, and a dark olive pill CTA button; right column is a full-bleed vertical video/image of a model mid-skincare gesture, cropped tight and bleeding to the top and right edge of the viewport. Below, a flush four-up grid of equal-width stat cards aligned to the same outer margins as the hero columns, creating a loose 12-column underlying grid.

ai.color_imagery: Muted warm-grey background, olive-green accent for CTA buttons, neutral beige/skin-tone photography with no color grading or duotone treatment; image is a straight photographic crop, no rounding or overlay, giving a clinical-but-soft contrast against the flat UI chrome.
ai.interaction: Implied video loop in the hero image area; chat widget bubble bottom-right suggesting a popup interaction; dropdown caret on "our services" nav item implies a mega or simple dropdown menu.
